title: Η φύση και οι εποχές
description: Ten short stories about nature through the year: a spring garden, a summer swim, an autumn walk in the mountains, a snowy winter, a school project, a beach clean-up, a village festival, a football match in the park, a trip to Crete and a doctor who prescribes walks in nature.

lessons.title: Άνοιξη στο σπίτι της γιαγιάς
lessons.summary: In spring Anna visits her grandmother in the village; they clean outside the house, cook and share the food with a neighbour.

lessons.title: Μπάνιο στη νότια παραλία
lessons.summary: On a summer day Nikos and his friends hurry to a beach in the south of the island, swim and take photos.

lessons.title: Με τον οδηγό στο βουνό
lessons.summary: On an autumn day Petros walks in the mountains with a group and a guide, who shows them how to walk safely and which way to go.

lessons.title: Ο χειμώνας και ο υπολογιστής
lessons.summary: In winter a strong wind cuts the power in Sofia's village and her old computer breaks, so she buys a new one in town.

lessons.title: Ο κύκλος των εποχών
lessons.summary: A teacher and her pupils study the four seasons, draw them, collect natural things outside and show their work at a small exhibition.

lessons.title: Καθαρή θάλασσα
lessons.summary: Dimitra's group for the protection of the sea cleans a beach with the help of a ministry, and many people come to help.

lessons.title: Η γιορτή του Αυγούστου
lessons.summary: Emma from Germany spends August in a Greek village, speaks Greek with a local family, dances at the village festival and goes to a party.

lessons.title: Ο αγώνας με τον αέρα
lessons.summary: On a windy spring day Aris's small football team plays against a strong team and wins in extra time.

lessons.title: Ταξίδι στη νότια Κρήτη
lessons.summary: In autumn Kostas and Maria book a trip to Crete with a travel agent and visit an old army building that is now a modern museum.

lessons.title: Η θεραπεία του δάσους
lessons.summary: A tired writer visits his doctor, who orders daily walks in the forest instead of medicine; the walks help him finish his book.
